title: The Era of Despair
subtitle: The Great Fire — The World Winter — The War Against Darkness

cards.title: The Great Fire — Fall of the Precursors
cards.text: A great conflagration swept across all of Wraeclast — "from north to south, a sea of raging flame." The Precursors perished. The Weapon (Third Edict) was left unfinished. A female scientist tried to complete it — cast the pieces into the sea, but died of her wounds.
cards.flavorText: "After the fire, the sky turned grey, ash began to fall, and the cold came..." — Grip of Winter

cards.title: The World Winter
cards.text: 1,000 years of frost — the Maraketh called it the World Winter, the Karui called it the Great Wasting. "Fair plains turned desolate and lightless." Each tribe tells its own story: great fires, centuries of barrenness, endless winter.
cards.flavorText: "The truth lies buried in all those stories. There was an ancient time of terror and hunger." — Matiki

cards.title: Lightless — Creatures from the Well of Souls
cards.text: Lightless (Abyssals) — creatures that were made, not born. "Every moment in light is agony." They serve Kulemak, the Lich Lord. Their power source: Well of Souls — a bottomless well of spirits, the origin of all necromancy. "From everywhere, every path, the Well is always below."
cards.flavorText: "There is no oblivion. Only screaming. Forever." — Lurking Creature

cards.title: The Third Pact — Alliance Against Darkness
cards.text: In desperation, all living things allied: humans, serpents, hyenas, golems — ancestral enemies held hands against the Abyssals. The Third Pact was born. Sin extracted Divinity from Kulemak, neutralizing him. The Dreamer received a drop of blood from each race.
cards.flavorText: "Whether serpent, hyena, human or golem, ancestral enemies held hands, built shelter, and fought together." — Against the Darkness

cards.title: Solerai & Lundara — Return to Light
cards.text: Twin Sekhemas — Solerai (golden) and Lundara (silver) — unified the Maraketh. "With a single strike, Solerai ended the World Winter." The Lightless retreated beneath the sands. Solerai may be Solaris, Lundara may be Lunaris.
cards.flavorText: "When hope was but a memory, twin Sekhemas rose to unite a scattered people." — Zarka

cards.title: The Rise of the Gods
cards.text: From the ashes, gods emerged. The Karui had Tukohama who united the tribes, Tawhoa who calmed the earth, Valako who tamed the skies. "There was a time of hunger, fire, and despair... then the gods rose from the ashes."
cards.flavorText: "Tukohama didn't just bring violence. He brought hope. Hope for all the tribes." — Matiki
